name: Domino on Windowsill
justification: Satisfying parity observation makes it a two-line check; unambiguous YES/NO.
solution_sketch: White cells can always be paired up greedily (vertical pairs then horizontal), so capacity is floor(white/2); same for black. Answer YES iff w<=(k1+k2)/2 and b<=(2n-k1-k2)/2.
